default.why: The exports are from 2017 coriolis-data and Coriolis code; small data and rounding changes since.

shieldExplRes.cause: Not explained. The export modifies the 3A generator's explres by +4.55% (additive, 0.5 + 0.0455), which gives a damage multiplier of 0.4545; Coriolis exported 0.48. Kinetic (+5.46%: 0.5454, exported 0.55) and thermal (+10.92%: 1.0908, exported 1.09) follow the same rule, so the explosive line looks stale.

unladenMass.cause: The Advanced Discovery Scanner (2 t) left the game and coriolis-data, so the build no longer has it: 88.25 - 2.

unladenRange.cause: 2 t less mass (see unladenMass). Range scales with 1/mass: 25.57 x (88.25 + 1.8) / (86.25 + 1.8), where 1.8 t is the 3A FSD's fuel for one jump.

totalKinSDps.cause: Coriolis changed its sustained dps formula after this export: Ship.js (2017) spread a clip over clip/rof + reload seconds; Module.getSustainedFactor now uses (clip - 1)/rof + reload, as the last shot needs no interval. Also the export used 2016 data, where this multi-cannon reloaded in 4 s; it is 5 s now. Today: dps 17.447006 (damage 1.64 x 1.2437, rof 7.6923 x 1.112 = 8.553846), clip 90: 17.447006 x (90/(89/8.553846 + 5))/8.553846 = 11.91652. The 2017 formula with a 4 s reload gives 12.6412, which is Coriolis's 12.64.
